status: PREDECLARED 2026-10-20 before any outcome of this search was computed. Research only: no live, MT5, BAT, SET, package or guard change.
request: Owner 2026-10-20: 'from all EAs we have find me the best risk management and trading approach that can get me funded within 3 months with pass rate of 70%+ for both phases if possible' (FTMO 2-step Swing $10k).
context: FTMO Fastest Funded Search 2026-10-20 development stage: no basket x cap (50/75/100/150, standard guard) reached a 70% average pass rate within 180 days on 2021-10..2023-10 starts (best 63.9%). This search varies the RISK-MANAGEMENT levers instead.
target: P(funded within 90 days) >= 70%, where funded = both phases passed + 5 business days review illustration (engine access_5bd_illustration), averaged over recorded and stress costs.
data_and_engine: Same frozen INPUTS-5y.json and eligibility as FTMO Fastest Funded Search 2026-10-20 (16 EAs, 3 Way Gold excluded), same core engine; new subclass RiskTrial parameterises the guard. With (cap1 = cap2 = c, latch 300, buffer 9200) it must reproduce the Fastest Search development results for the same basket/cap exactly (parity check, else stop).

levers.basket_note: the six best development baskets of the Fastest Search at any cap, plus every eligible EA (FTMO_ALL); chosen from development results only
levers.fixed: hard FTMO failure at equity <= 9000 or day loss >= 500 (unchanged); aggregate 225*(c/50), same-symbol 150*(c/50); 7 entries / 3 losing closes per day; margin proxy; 3s reconciliation; targets 11000 / 10500 after 4 entry days, flat.

configurations: 7 baskets x 3 caps x 2 phase-2 rules x 2 latches x 2 buffers = 168, all counted
data_split: development starts 2021-10-07 .. horizon <= 2023-10-06; validation 2023-10-06 .. 2024-10-06; OOS 2024-10-06 .. 2026-10-06 (previously inspected, retrospective).

selection.development_eligibility: avg P(funded <= 90 d) >= 70% AND breach share <= 5% in both cost scenarios (pipeline-policy maximum breach probability)
selection.rank: avg P(funded <= 90 d) desc, then breach share asc, then avg median days to funded asc, then lower cap
selection.no_eligible_result: If none reaches 70%, finalists = top 5 by avg P(funded <= 90 d) among configurations with breach share <= 5%, reported as NOT meeting the target. No thresholds relaxed or levers added after outcomes.
selection.validation_and_oos: finalists run once on validation and once on OOS; choice = best validation finalist meeting the target, else highest validation P(funded <= 90 d).

optimization: risk-lever menu with chronological dev / validation / OOS split; EA signal logic unchanged
